viewpoints.name: Overlook deck
viewpoints.blurb: Stand on the brass compass rose. The lake opens to the north and the aurora ripples above the peaks.

viewpoints.name: Lantern jetty
viewpoints.blurb: Walk to the end of the old jetty. Water on three sides, fireflies drifting over the shallows.

viewpoints.name: Summit ledge
viewpoints.blurb: Climb the southern ridge for the whole valley: deck, lake and the northern lights in one sweep.
